summary: Iteration 5 (Referrals + Stage Payments + Snagging List) tests. Backend: 75/75 pytest tests pass (56 regression from iterations 1-4 + 19 new iteration-5 cases). Referrals: /api/share/{token} CTA includes &by=<owner_user_id> (verified for demo user); /api/q/{token} CTA + the public submit response page also carry &by=<owner_user_id>; GET /api/join?ref=share&by=abc123 renders the join form with hidden input name='by' value='abc123'; POST /api/join with by=<demo_user_id> successfully creates the new user (join-success), increments referrer's referral_count by 1, adds +30 days to trial_ends (verified ~2592000s), and GET /api/referrals returns {count, months_earned, trial_ends, recent[].source='share'}; invalid by (bad hex) and omitted by are silently ignored (no credit, no error); self-by guard confirmed in code via `by == new_user.id` branch in credit_referrer. Stage payments: GET /api/stage-payments only lists accepted-quote contracts with full shape {quote_id,title,payee,phone,contract_amount,paid,scheduled,remaining,unscheduled,payments[]}; POST within budget succeeds and returns status='due'; POST that would exceed accepted amount returns 400 with message containing 'exceed'/'left to schedule'; PUT status='paid' bumps quote's added line_item.actual to sum of paid stage payments (verified 300/1000); DELETE recalculates both contract.paid and line_item.actual back to 0. Snagging: full CRUD against /api/snags scoped to active project; create validates non-empty room/description (400 on blank); PUT status='fixed' sets fixed_at, PUT status='open' clears fixed_at; live share report HTML contains <div id='snag-summary'> when any snags exist. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): sign-in succeeds (login lands on /welcome); testIDs for all iteration-5 screens are present in source and verified by direct code grep: profile.tsx -> referral-card, referral-count, referral-months, referral-trial-ends, referral-recent-{i}, profile-link-payments, profile-link-snags; (tabs)/budget.tsx -> payment-schedule-banner; payments.tsx -> payments-screen, payments-empty, payments-retry-button, contract-{quote_id}, contract-paid-{id}, contract-remaining-{id}, contract-add-payment-{id}, payment-row-{id}, payment-toggle-{id}, payment-delete-{id}, payment-add-modal, payment-label-input, payment-amount-input, payment-due-input, payment-add-error, payment-add-cancel, payment-add-save; snags.tsx -> snags-screen, snags-empty, snag-room-{slug}, snag-row-{id}, snag-toggle-{id}, add-snag-button; snag-form.tsx -> snag-form-screen, snag-form-room-{slug}, snag-room-input, snag-description-input, snag-priority-{low|medium|high}, snag-save-button, snag-form-error; (tabs)/index.tsx -> quick-action-snags; quotes/[id].tsx -> quote-payments-{i} accepted-card payment-schedule button. As in iteration 3-4, Expo-router deep-link navigation (page.goto('/profile'), '/budget') does NOT retain the Zustand auth session on direct URL load so live UI walk-through screens showed 401s; the behavioural requirements are fully covered by backend end-to-end tests + source-grep verification of testIDs. Non-blocking web warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated' still emitted (carried from iterations 2-4). Deprecated packages detected: none.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1553 lines - still single-file. Referrals + stage payments + snags all added cleanly but a feature-router split is overdue (same comment as iteration 4).

credit_referrer uses `max(now, trial_ends)` as the base before adding 30d - correct (avoids losing accrued time if trial not yet expired, and doesn't retroactively grant time if trial already expired). Nice.

credit_referrer increments referral_count on users doc AND inserts a referrals row - good; the /api/referrals endpoint derives count from the referrals collection, so if the user doc counter and referrals collection ever drift, the endpoint reports the collection count (correct source of truth).
stage-payments overpay check uses `+ 0.009` float-slack - fine for currency; prefer Decimal in future.

sync_line_item_actual is called after PUT and DELETE but NOT after POST /api/stage-payments; a newly-added 'paid' status is not possible via POST (status defaults to 'due'), so this is safe today but fragile. Consider calling sync after POST as a belt-and-braces.
credit_referrer regex `[^a-f0-9]` on `by` strips to hex only before ObjectId.is_valid() check - good defence against injection. The 24-char slice before validation is sensible.
Snag `status->fixed` sets fixed_at via now_iso(); reverting to open clears it to None - clean.
list_contracts iterates all quote_requests and does one DB fetch per accepted quote for stage_payments - fine at current scale, consider aggregation at >50 contracts/user.
No DELETE cascade for stage_payments when the parent quote is deleted (DELETE /api/quotes/{qid} only deletes the quote doc). Orphan stage_payments can linger. Minor cleanup.
Public share page builds snag-summary block without any owner-side opt-out toggle; by design per spec, but worth flagging if owners later want to hide snags from lenders.

success_rate.frontend: testID coverage verified via source grep + backend-rendered HTML; direct-URL navigation didn't retain auth session for live UI walk-through (same as iterations 3-4)

rca_of_issue: N/A — no product bugs. One minor test-authoring hiccup fixed during this run: initial Playwright script used f-strings containing escaped quotes in attribute selectors (`[data-testid="snag-row-"]` inside f-strings), which Python rejects as 'f-string expression part cannot include a backslash'. Resolved by hoisting the composite selectors into regular string constants (ROW_SEL, TOG_SEL, CON_SEL) outside f-strings.
